newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Dec 4.

text.p: * Baxter International Inc said it agreed to acquire Research Medical Inc in a stock deal worth about $236 million, or $23.50 per Research share. Baxter shares closed on Tuesday at 41 and Research closed at 20.

* Delta Air Lines Inc and Continental Airlines Inc are in talks on a possible merger, the New York Times reported. Delta declined comment on the report. Delta closed at 75 and Continental Class B shares closed at 28-3/8.

* Tele-Communications Inc said its board will consider today the spin-off of its holdings in Tele-Communications International Inc and Liberty Media Corp. TCI closed at 14-1/8, TCI International closed at 14-7/8, and Liberty Media closed at 24-1/4.

* Carver Corp said it expects to post a loss for the fourth quarter. The company, which had expected a profit, cited a delay in the shipment of two audio products by one of its new vendors. Carver closed at 3-1/4.
